summary: Introduces the foundational workflow ecosystem for creating, validating, inspecting, and safely rendering reusable economic analyses.
highlights: New `workflow` commands manage repository- and collection-aware YAML definitions
Static workflows and dynamic positional contracts support zero or multiple runtime inputs
`workflow render` resolves stages into one copy-ready pipeline command without executing it
`workflow contract` prints input labels, formats, samples, and descriptions
Workflow validation rejects unknown YAML fields, unsafe namespace paths, and incompatible RESERVE versions
The experimental `snippet` command and configuration surface have been removed in favor of workflows
update_instructions: Download the latest release from the GitHub releases page or rerun the install script from download.reservecli.dev.
